तिष्ठद्गु ind. At the time when
cows stand to be milked (i. e. after
an hour or an hour and a half after
evening); आतिष्ठद्गु जपन् संध्यां

तिष्ठद्धोमः A sacrifice at which
the oblation is offered by a priest
standing.

तिष्य a. [तुष्यंत्यस्मिन् तुष्-क्यप् नि˚]
1 Auspicious, fortunate.
--2 Born
under the asterism पुष्य.
--ष्यः
1
The eighth of the 27 constellations,
(also called पुष्य).
--2 The lunar
month Pauṣa.
--ष्यं The Kali Yuga.
--Comp.
--केतुः an epithet of Śiva.
